bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_CONTAINER_MISSING; exit 61; }
status="$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$name")"
restarts="$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$name")"
logs="$(docker logs --tail 120 "$name" 2>&1 || true)"
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' && test "$status" = running;then echo STK04_DM_READY_LOG=PASS; exit 0;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_POLL_RUNTIME_FAILED$';then echo STK04_RUNTIME_FAILURE_GENERIC=YES; exit 80;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_POLL_EXISTING_WEBHOOK_MUST_NOT_BE_REPLACED$';then exit 81;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_POLL_PRIVATE_SECRET_MOUNT_REQUIRED$';then exit 82;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_POLL_DB_PASSWORD_FILE_INVALID$';then exit 83;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_POLL_INTERNAL_DB_CONFIG_INVALID$';then exit 84;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_POLL_SCHEMA_INCOMPLETE$';then exit 85;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND|Cannot find module';then exit 86;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_POLL_PRIVATE_MODE_REQUIRED';then exit 87;fi
if test "$status" = restarting;then exit 88;fi
if test "$status" != running;then exit 89;fi
if test "$restarts" -ge 3;then exit 90;fi
exit 91
